title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be an active hands-on contributor as well as a strong influencer for our technical direction. You will be able to lead and contribute to significant initiatives as well as provide mentorship through code reviews and pairing.

We are especially excited to hear from you if you are enthusiastic about working in the luxury retail/e-commerce space or passionate about our mission to create a circular economy for high-end goods.

This role reports to the Engineering Manager of Customer Experience and will be fully remote.


What You Bring To The Role

- 5+ years professional software development experience

- Fluency with either Elixir or Ruby

- Proficient with the latest versions of ECMAScript (JavaScript) as well as HTML and CSS

- Experience with React and common tools used in the wider React ecosystem, such as Node.js and npm

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event-based architectures, database fundamentals and GraphQL

- Enthusiasm for solving problems for our users with technology

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce , the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods.


Bonus Points

Experience with Kafka for event-streaming

Experience extracting microservices from a monolith


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Consultor de Investimentos B2B/B2B2C
description:
Empreenda como Consultor Independente com a Revert - B2B/B2B2C


Você buscou ser livre.

Mas a operação te prendeu de novo.

Relatório pra um cliente.

Conciliação de outro.

Extrato que não bate.

E-mail cobrando posição.


No fim, você virou consultor pra passar mais tempo com cliente…

e está passando mais tempo com planilha.


O que é a Revert


A Revert é uma empresa de tecnologia baseada em serviços, criando um ecossistema de consultorias de investimentos independente, construída para tirar o peso da operação do consultor.


Aqui, a lógica é simples:

enquanto você está com o cliente, a operação roda por trás.

  • Consolidação de carteira automática
  • Suporte operacional completo
  • Uso de tecnologia e IA para ganho de escala
  • Atendimento em múltiplas instituições (sem ficar preso a uma plataforma)
  • Acesso a TODOS os bancos.


Não é software.

É o serviço funcionando por você.


Para quem é

Essa oportunidade é para quem:

  • Já tem carteira de clientes no mundo consultoria
  • Quer parar de perder tempo com operacional
  • Busca mais tempo de qualidade com o cliente
  • Quer escalar sua atuação como consultor independente


⚠️ Importante

Estamos no início e sendo seletivos com nossos parceitos.

Fazemos poucas parcerias — com quem realmente quer construir algo grande.


Interessou?

  • Se fez sentido, vamos conversar.

title: ServiceNow Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for ServiceNow Developer who wants to learn and transform his career.


Mandatory Skills :

  • Strong JavaScript skills (Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, ACLs)
  • ServiceNow configuration & development (Flow Designer, forms, workflows)
  • Integrations (REST APIs , IntegrationHub)
  • CMDB fundamentals (CI classes, relationships, data quality concepts)
  • Experience with enterprise SDLC /change management processes


Desirable Skills:

  • CSDM knowledge and service mapping alignment
  • Discovery/Service Mapping exposure (normalization/deduplication)
  • Experience with AI features (Now Assist, AI Search)
  • App Engine / scoped application development
  • Experience with ATF
  • Certifications ( CSA, CAD, CIS)


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and configure ServiceNow using an OOTB-first approach
  • Improve and maintain CMDB structure, relationships, and data quality
  • Support CSDM alignment across service models and portfolios Build and enhance custom applications, flows, UI policies, and automations
  • Develop and support integrations using IntegrationHub, REST, MID Server
  • Enable and support AI features following governance and security standards Perform troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and reduce technical debt Execute QA activities (unit, functional, regression testing) and maintain test evidence
  • Produce and maintain clear technical documentation
  • Support platform upgrades and ensure upgrade-safe solutions

title: Senior AI Software Engineer | .NET
description:
Muito prazer, Somos a Evertec!


A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro , com mais de 27 anos de atuação e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe. Com mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente, somos referência em soluções que impulsionam a transformação digital do mercado.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software , atendendo instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs que buscam inovação, segurança e eficiência .

Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica , a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros, promovendo um ecossistema mais conectado e acessível.


A área de AI Office é responsável por iniciativas e direcionamentos de IA na empresa e busca um Engenheiro de Software Sênior para compor nosso time, na maior empresa de desenvolvimento de softwares e produtos para o mercado financeiro do Brasil, onde acreditamos que a inovação tecnológica inspira a evolução


Esse cargo será responsável por:

  • Pesquisa em IA
  • Modernização de software legados
  • Desenvolvimento de novos Produtos
  • Foco em eficiência e crescimento através de P&D em IA


Para dar #match, essa vaga necessita que atenda alguns requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Especialidade em Engenharia de Software em nível avançado, com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento .NET
  • Conhecimentos avançados em uso de IA
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de novos produtos
  • Histórico robusto em desenvolvimento e arquitetura de software.
  • Conhecimento sólido em metodologias ágeis, gestão de processos e produtos.
  • Habilidade comprovada em integrar diferentes áreas e alcançar alta performance.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Modelagem de Dados, Integrações, Python e plataformas como Azure ,GCP e/ou Aws.
  • Experiência prática em automação e otimização de processos empresariais.

title: Level 1 Support Specialist
description:
Level 1 IT Support Specialist (SAP Experience Required)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Contract - 3 months initially

Daily Rate: €60 – €70 per day

Job Overview

We are looking for a Level 1 IT Support Specialist to join our team and provide first-line technical support to end users. The ideal candidate will have basic experience with SAP systems and a strong customer-focused mindset. You will be responsible for handling initial support requests, troubleshooting common issues, and escalating more complex problems when necessary.


  • Provide first-level technical support via phone, email, or ticketing system
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic IT and SAP-related issues
  • Log, track, and manage support tickets in the system
  • Escalate unresolved or complex issues to Level 2 support teams
  • Assist users with SAP login issues, navigation, and basic functionality
  • Maintain accurate documentation of issues and resolutions
  • Follow standard support procedures and service level agreements (SLAs)


Requirements

  • Basic experience working with SAP (any module is a plus)
  • Previous experience in IT support, helpdesk, or customer service role preferred
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Basic knowledge of Windows OS, Microsoft Office, and common IT tools
  • Good organizational and time management skills
  • High level of English


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, Zendesk)
  • Understanding of ITIL principles
  • Multilingual skills (if applicable)

title: Agentic Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Agentic Developer with 8+ years of experience in .NET, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar to join our client's Web / Foundations Team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our client's core web platform, a mission-critical SaaS system that supports real-world customer workflows across healthcare, legal, education, and enterprise environments. You will play a key role in building and enhancing core product capabilities while ensuring reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

In this context, agentic development refers to the structured use of AI

agents and LLM-powered workflows as part of the software development

lifecycle. This includes using agents to assist with design, implementation,

testing, debugging, and code quality while maintaining full ownership of

correctness and production readiness.

As a senior individual contributor, you will take ownership of systems end-to-end, influence architectural decisions, and help modernize the platform to meet growing business needs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, improve system performance, and elevate engineering standards. This is a high-impact position suited for engineers who think in systems, understand trade-offs, and can make sound technical decisions in a live, customer-facing environment.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI-powered solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain critical systems and services across the client's platform
  • Develop scalable, secure, multi-tenant features and services used by customers and internal teams
  • Build and maintain backend APIs and service-to-service integrations
  • Contribute to modern web applications using Angular or comparable frontend frameworks
  • Improve system reliability, performance, observability, and maintainability
  • Help modernize legacy components while preserving stability in a live SaaS platform
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, technical standards, and engineering patterns
  • Write and maintain automated tests
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical problem-solving
  • Mentor engineers and help raise technical standards across the team
  • Participate in incident response and operational improvement as needed
  • AI / Agentic Responsibilities:
  • Use AI agents and LLM-based tools as a core part of daily development workflows
  • Apply agents to support:

Requirements clarification

System design

Code generation and refactoring

Debugging and root cause analysis

Test creation and validation

Code review and quality improvement

Critically evaluate, challenge, and refine AI-generated outputs to ensure production-grade quality

Contribute to evolving best practices for agent-assisted development within the team


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 8+ years of experience in back-end development using C#, .NET, Python, Node.js, or similar
  • Proven hands-on experience using agentic tools and development workflows in day-to-day software engineering
  • Experience building and maintaining SaaS platforms
  • Experience building modern web applications using Angular, React.js, or similar frameworks
  • Experience designing and supporting APIs, integrations, and service-to-service communication
  • Experience working with distributed systems, microservices, service-oriented architecture, or event-driven systems
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests, including unit and integration tests
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
  • Experience using agents to support requirements clarification, solution design, code generation, refactoring, debugging, code review, and test creation
  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience applying test-driven development (TDD), test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design, including messaging, event flows, and distributed system behavior
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail, including reviewing and improving agent-assisted output
  • Experience applying secure coding practices and working within engineering workflows that include quality and security controls
  • AI / Agentic
  • Proven hands-on experience using AI agents, orchestration tools, or structured LLM workflows in real development environments
  • Experience using agents to support:

Requirements clarification

Solution design

Code generation

Refactoring

Debugging

Code review

Test creation

  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience working with tools or frameworks such as: LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar

custom-built agent workflows

  • Strong understanding of limitations, failure modes, and trade-offs of LLM-based systems


Preferred Experience

  • Experience modernizing or untangling legacy web platforms
  • Experience with multi-tenant systems
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, observability tooling, and operational support in distributed systems
  • Experience in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments
  • Experience improving performance, stability, and operational maturity in customer-facing SaaS platforms
  • Experience applying TDD, test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail
  • Experience applying secure coding practices and working within engineering workflows that include quality and security controls


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together.
  • Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions.
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment.
  • Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Buscamos por pessoas engajadas, focadas e determinadas em ir além.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our growing DevOps team in Brazil. You’ll work closely with international engineering teams, helping to design, automate, and operate reliable, secure, and scalable systems in a production-critical environment.


This is a hands-on role with end-to-end ownership , exposure to modern DevOps tooling, and opportunities to mentor junior engineers while contributing to platform stability and continuous improvement.


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Design, maintain, and enhance CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions
  • Manage and support deployments across:
  • OpenShift / Kubernetes
  • AWS
  • Bare-metal infrastructure (low-latency systems)
  • Automate infrastructure and application configuration using Ansible
  • Support and troubleshoot Unix/Linux systems , with integration into Windows environments
  • Implement monitoring and observability using:
  • Dynatrace (system monitoring and alerting)
  • ELK Stack (centralized logging)
  • Collaborate with engineering teams using GitHub , Jira , and Confluence
  • Participate in release activities, including:
  • Planned deployments
  • Post-release verification
  • Incident investigation and root cause analysis
  • Join a rotational weekend release schedule (approx. 1 weekend in every 5)
  • Mentor and support the development of junior DevOps engineers
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools (GitHub Copilot, Rovo, Devin) to improve delivery and operational efficiency
  • Continuously improve documentation, standards, and DevOps best practices


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Advanced English
  • Strong Unix/Linux administration experience
  • Ansible : solid experience writing and maintaining playbooks and roles
  • Git : confident using collaborative workflows
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins and/or GitHub Actions)
  • Experience running workloads on Kubernetes / OpenShift
  • Scripting or coding skills (Bash, Python, or similar )
  • Experience supporting production systems


Nice to Have


  • AWS experience
  • Exposure to bare-metal infrastructure
  • ELK Stack administration
  • Dynatrace configuration and dashboarding
  • Windows Server administration
  • Experience in banking, finance, or FX
  • Exposure to regulated environments
  • Experience working in Kanban teams

title: Senior Voip Engineer
description:
About the role

We are hiring a Senior VoIP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.

This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.

This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.

What you'll do

  • Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
  • Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
  • Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
  • Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
  • Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.

What we're looking for:


Required

  • 5+ years as a developer building VoIP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
  • Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:

A B2BUA / media server: Asterisk or FreeSWITCH

A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or OpenSIPS

  • Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
  • Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
  • Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Strong plus

  • Python for automation, tooling, or service development.
  • SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS).
  • DevOps and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, WebRTC gateways, or SBCs.
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.


Why this role

  • Fully remote with a flexible working model.
  • Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
  • High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
  • Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
  • Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Project Manager - Digital Technology
description:
Project Manager - Digital Technology


Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Digital Technology (DT) Project Manager to join our team. The DT Project Manager will be responsible for planning, leading, organizing, and motivating project teams to achieve a high level of performance and quality in delivering projects that provide exceptional business value to users. This role requires a high degree of collaboration with leaders across the organization.

  • Key Responsibilities:Project Planning and Management: Full project life cycle ownership: successful project delivery will include full implementation from initiation to deployment.


  • Scope, Schedule, and Resource Management: Manage all aspects of projects including scope, schedule, resources, quality, costs, change, and risk to ensure the overall program is aligned to and directly supports the achievement of strategic objectives.


  • Financial Management: Oversee project budgets, track expenditures, and ensure financial objectives are met. Provide regular financial reports and forecasts to stakeholders.


  • Project Monitoring & Control: Prepare estimates and detailed project plan for all phases of the project. Manage the day-to-day project activities and resources.


  • Transparency and Reporting: Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks & issues, communicating across leadership.


  • Agile Practices: Organize and facilitate release planning, daily stand-up meetings, and reviews. Track and communicate scrum metrics including team velocity and sprint/release progress.


  • Quality Management: Manage ongoing quality control and participate in quality issue resolution.


  • Risk Management: Identify and manage project risks and issues, and develop mitigation plans
  • Experience and Skills: Experience in Agile & Waterfall methodologies.


  • Excellent communication (written, verbal and presentation) and interpersonal skills.


  • Experience in successfully leading projects and programs to from initiation to closure.


  • Experience working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.


  • Experience partnering with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams.


  • Flexible with proven ability to conform to shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities.


  • Flexible work hours when needed to align with counterparts at other Otis locations.


  • Support diverse and inclusive work environment.


  • Bachelor's Degree of Computer Science, IT, MIS or equivalent work experience.


  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on project management experience, including initiating, tracking and planning projects.


  • Intermediate level of proficiency with MS Office, MS Project, PPM and Agile tools.


  • PMP Certification required. Agile certifications are highly desirable

title: Full Stack Engineer (Laravel, Redux, and TypeScript)
description:
DomainTools is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Internal Team. This position is perfect for someone interested in building powerful cybersecurity products and features for our enterprise customers. Our solutions help fuel mission critical efforts for customers including gathering threat intelligence, doing threat hunting, and performing online fraud investigation, and more.


At DomainTools, you will work as part of a collaborative team of smart and engaged engineers. Expect to spend most of your time developing modern JavaScript single page applications powered by PHR middleware APIs. You will work in an environment where productivity is fostered. You will spend very little time in meetings, and you won’t be distracted by processes that get in the way of high-quality results.


Have you worked with modern PHP OOP frameworks such as Laravel of Symfony? Are you well versed in using CSS and UX to make beautiful and streamlined designs? Have you built successful end to end testing solutions? If you answered yes to any of these questions we would like to chat with you. However, it is required that you are very comfortable with JavaScript.


Job Responsibilities

  • Produce well designed, testable, efficient code using software development best practices.
  • Integrate with and utilize data from backend services and databases.
  • Build web applications using PHP on the backend and JavaScript (ES7+), HTML5, and CSS3 on the frontend.
  • Contribute to new product ideation and implementation as well as to feature development of existing products.
  • Collaborate with teammates by actively participating in code reviews, contributing to technical documentation, and offering constructive design feedback.
  • Become a subject matter expert on DomainTools’ customer facing products and services.


Key Applicant Qualifications

  • Work experience: 3+ years of modern web application development.
  • Experience with modern PHP frameworks (Laravel, Symfony).
  • Solid knowledge of the following:
  • Object oriented PHP 7+ programming
  • JavaScript (ES7+)
  • TypeScript
  • HTML5 and CSS3
  • Deep understanding of React 18+ and Redux.
  • Experience with unit and integration testing (PHPUnit, Jest).
  • Demonstrable experience building and consuming APIs.
  • Proficiency with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Experience with container technologies, particularly Docker.


Pluses

  • Familiarity with configuring Babel, Webpack, and ESLint.
  • Experience with orchestration platforms, particularly Kubernetes.
  • Experience with user acceptance/E2E testing (TestCafe, Playwright).
  • Familiarity interacting with relational databases (MySQL).
  • Experience with UX design and related concepts.
  • Experience using agile principles and methodologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field.


More Details:

  • 100% remote in Brazil
  • Salary: up to $53,000per annum

Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. title: Sitecore Engineering Manager
description:
Digital Experience Engineering Manager

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Long Term Contract


Description:

Step into a pivotal leadership role as a Digital Experience Engineering Manager, where you'll guide a team of talented Sitecore developers and web technology experts to deliver innovative and scalable digital solutions. Your influence will shape the future of our web platforms, ensuring they meet the highest standards of quality, performance, and security. In this dynamic position, you'll have the opportunity to drive technological excellence, mentor a high-performing team, and play a key role in transforming business goals into cutting-edge digital experiences. If you are passionate about leading teams, driving innovation, and making a tangible impact, we invite you to lead with us and propel our digital capabilities to new heights.

If you are excited to make a difference applying cutting-edge technologies to solve real business challenges and add value to a global, market-leading organization, please come join us!


Key Interfaces:

Internal: NA Marketing VP, NA Marketing Brands and Product Teams, NA D&A Product Managers; Legal Team, DTS Cloud Team; DTS Enterprise Architecture Team; NA DTS Team.

External: Marketing Agencies, Third Party Providers.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of developers and web technology professionals, fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Oversee the design, development, and deployment of high-quality, scalable web solutions that align with business strategies and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with UX/UI designers, product managers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and delivery of web projects.
  • Implement and enforce best practices in software development, including code quality, performance optimization, and security measures.
  • Drive the adoption of modern technologies and methodologies to enhance the team's capabilities and deliver innovative solutions.
  • Manage timelines, resources, and budgets, ensuring that all initiatives are completed on time and within scope.
  • Lead the strategy for web and digital technology, aligning with organizational goals and driving digital transformation.
  • Stay current with emerging technology trends and integrate relevant advancements into the team's work.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement, encouraging the team to stay ahead of industry trends and technological advancements.
  • Ensure that all development and web solutions comply with relevant data privacy regulations such as CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other global privacy standards.
  • Implement mechanisms for handling user consent, managing data access controls, and ensuring that all data collection practices align with legal requirements.
  • Act as a point of escalation for technical issues, providing solutions and guiding the team through complex challenges.
  • Collaborate with other engineering managers and leaders to align on technical strategies and share best practices.
  • Report on progress, team performance, and technological advancements to senior leadership.
  • Lead the team's efforts in troubleshooting and resolving issues, ensuring minimal disruption to project timelines.


Required Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in information technology leading remote, global teams across time zones and a minimum of 5 years of experience in product or engineering management.
  • 8+ years of experience and deep understanding of digital marketing technologies is required, specifically in web development.
  • Strong expertise in Sitecore CMS and other web technologies with experience in building, delivering, and operating digital platforms
  • Technical leadership experience with solution architecture, software development, engineering management, and application delivery, including CICD, SDLC, and MACH architecture practices
  • Proven track record in leading and delivering complex digital projects.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and guide a team.
  • Deep understanding of Agile methodologies and project management tools.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make strategic decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong knowledge of data privacy regulations like CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and their implications for web development.
  • Experience implementing data protection mechanisms, including consent management, data encryption, and access controls.
  • Familiarity with One Trust or similar systems privacy and compliance features, including the ability to configure and enforce data protection settings.
  • Proven ability and experience in building highly skilled product teams and mentoring a team of developers.
  • Strong sense of urgency in delivering results and high cross-cultural awareness and sensitivity.
  • Operate as a change agent at multiple levels of an organization with outstanding organizational, communication, interpersonal, relationship-building skills conducive to collaboration at all levels.

title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Buscar inspiração no mercado para trazer novas ideias que possam ser utilizadas para melhorar a plataforma de dados;
  • Atuar ativamente na detecção e na solução de problemas, oportunidades e melhorias relacionados à disciplina de dados na tecnologia;
  • Garantir que o time esteja alinhado com evolução da plataforma e todos entendam as motivações por trás delas;
  • Identificar e antecipar impactos das abordagens em outros produtos cross-squads;
  • Trazer a visão do todo, ao colaborar com o planejamento, acompanhamento e organização de uma dada iniciativa que visa onde outro analista, seja responsável, até a entrega de valor, ajudando a mapear os possíveis riscos e impactos;
  • Orientar, engajar e fomentar proativamente a cultura data driven em toda a Empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou área relacionada;
  • Python;
  • SQL;
  • Conceitos de administração de banco de dados;
  • Conceitos de DW;
  • Shell;
  • Alguma ferramenta/linguagem de IaC: terraform, ansible, puppet;
  • Conceitos de infraestrutura (rede, disco, cpu...);
  • Proficiência com containers (docker, kubernetes);
  • Conceitos de engenharia de software (protocolos de API, SoC, SOLID e etc);
  • Conceitos de sistemas com uso intensivo de dados: lakehouse, data lake, DW MPP;
  • Proficiência com ferramentas de processamento em streaming: kafka, spark, flink;
  • Conceitos de streaming de dados: hopping, session, tumbling;
  • Proficiência com bancos nosql: mongo, cassandra (scyllaDB), druid
  • Conceitos de arquiteturas de sistemas distribuidos: ring, master/worker;
  • Conceitos de machine learning: treino, serving, feature, reinforcement learning;
  • Proficiência com infraestrutura em cloud.



#SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Salesforce TPM Analyst
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Technical Program Manager (Salesforce TPM)

A Technical Program Manager at Salesforce (or in a Salesforce-focused role) is responsible for the end-to-end execution of complex technical initiatives. They bridge the gap between high-level organizational strategy and technical engineering execution.


Core Responsibilities:

Program Delivery: Overseeing the software development lifecycle (SDLC) from initiation to completion using Agile and Lean methodologies.

Stakeholder Alignment: Leading Steering Committee meetings to make key decisions, remove obstacles, and align vision across cross-functional teams (Product Owners, Scrum Leads, UX).

Risk & Dependency Management: Proactively identifying blockers, managing dependencies across multiple scrum teams, and developing mitigation strategies.

Process Improvement: Driving engineering excellence by refining release planning and program structures.


Required Skills:

Experience: Typically in enterprise software or technical program management.

Technical Depth: Deep understanding of SaaS/PaaS business models and the ability to master technical subjects relevant to the program.

Communication: Outstanding executive presence with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.


Trade Promotion Management (Salesforce TPM)

If the role is specifically for Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, TPM refers to a consultant or manager who optimizes how brands manage trade spend and promotions.

Getmereferred.com

Getmereferred.com


Core Responsibilities:

TPM Implementation: Designing and configuring components like promotion planning, fund management, and claims settlement.

Industry Expertise: Applying knowledge of the Consumer Goods (CPG) industry to drive ROI through AI-powered scenario modeling and budget optimization.

Integration: Ensuring TPM solutions integrate seamlessly with other modules like Sales Cloud or Marketing Cloud.

Required Skills:

Strong understanding of the TPM lifecycle: planning, budgeting, execution, and analytics.

Certifications in Salesforce (Admin, Platform App Builder) are often mandatory for these specialist roles.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior/Principal .NET Developer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for passionate and creative engineers who are eager to build innovative products and embrace new technologies at a leading hedge fund. You will be part of a small, agile, and highly skilled team of technologists building next‑generation platforms to optimize investment decisions.


Responsibilities:

As a Frameworks Developer, you will play a key role in building and evolving the firm’s core application framework used by development teams across the organization. This is a highly collaborative, hands‑on role with broad impact.


Key responsibilities:

- Plan, develop, and support the firm’s in‑house application framework

- Define and contribute to low‑level architecture and core design decisions

- Partner with development teams to help kickstart new projects and provide technical expertise

- Collaborate with developers and business users across the organization to deliver mission‑critical platforms and services

- Support investment professionals across equities, credit, and other major asset classes

- Work closely with the broader Technology team on cross‑functional initiatives


Mandatory Skills Description:

- At least 8 years of professional software development experience

Deep expertise in

- C#,

- ASP.NET,

- SQL Server

- Good working knowledge of Angular, JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML, CSS

- Full SDLC experience: requirements, implementation, testing, release, and support

- Strong focus on clean, high‑performance code (SOLID principles)

- Experience with multi‑threaded programming

- Proven ability to build scalable, high‑availability applications and support production systems

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including technical discussions

- Strong team‑oriented, collaborative working style

- Independent, proactive mindset with a high level of ownership and collaboration


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- CI/CD systems (TeamCity, Octopus Deploy)

- Financial products (equities, derivatives, fixed income, etc. and related terminology)

- Order management systems (i.e., Charles River)

- Working with market data (i.e., Bloomberg Terminal, Bloomberg APIs)

- Workload automation and enterprise job scheduling software (i.e., ActiveBatch)

- Profiling and performance tuning techniques throughout the whole stack


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Associate II, Pharmacovigilance - Brazil - Remote
description:
What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide


Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.


What you will do


  • Author Safety Management Plan for assigned studies
  • Attend and present at Investigator Meetings
  • Review incoming SAE data for completeness and accuracy
  • Perform data entry in the Safety Database and/or complete applicable tracking of incoming safety information
  • Perform QC of SAEs processed by other PV Associates
  • Generate regulatory reports and perform safety submissions as needed


What you will bring to the role


  • Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements
  • Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines
  • Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilities


Your experience


  • Minimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials)
  • Bachelor’s degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
  • Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment
  • Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting)
  • Fluent in written and verbal English

description:
What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide


Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.


What you will do


  • Author Safety Management Plan for assigned studies

What you will bring to the role


  • Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements
  • Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines
  • Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilities


Your experience


  • Minimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials)
  • Bachelor’s degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
  • Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment
  • Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting)
  • Fluent in written and verbal English

title: Reconciliation Systems Architect (IntelliMatch DIM)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced IntelliMatch (DIM) Solution Architect to lead the design, development, and evolution of our reconciliation platform. This role combines architectural ownership with hands-on technical expertise , playing a key role in delivering scalable and efficient reconciliation solutions across global banking systems.

You will act as a technical authority , guiding development, support, and functional teams while ensuring best practices, performance, and architectural integrity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own end-to-end architecture for IntelliMatch (DIM) solutions
  • Lead hands-on development , including configurations, enhancements, and automation
  • Design and implement SQL-based reconciliation logic and workflows
  • Establish and enforce technical standards and best practices
  • Drive integration strategies between IntelliMatch and upstream/downstream systems
  • Act as technical lead during delivery , ensuring quality across implementation, testing, and release
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on backlog prioritization and solution planning
  • Analyze existing systems to identify performance and architectural improvements
  • Maintain detailed architecture documentation and design artifacts

✅ Must-Have (Non-Negotiable Skills)

  • ✔ IntelliMatch (DIM) experience (Version 20+)
  • ✔ Strong hands-on experience in IntelliMatch architecture & development
  • ✔ Advanced SQL / MS SQL Server expertise
  • ✔ Experience in reconciliation / financial systems
  • ✔ Ability to work hands-on + architect-level

⭐ Good to Have

  • Experience with PowerShell / Python scripting
  • Exposure to Azure / cloud platforms
  • Experience with JIRA / Agile methodologies
  • Banking or financial services domain experience

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT / Computer Science / Software Engineering
  • 10+ years of experience in IntelliMatch (DIM) or similar reconciliation platforms
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

title: .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: .NET Developer

Location: Remote (Brazil-based only)

Salary: $3,500-4,500 per month

Job Type: Contract

Experience Level: Senior Level


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled .NET Developer to join our growing development team. This fully remote role is open to candidates based in Brazil and offers the opportunity to work on modern application development projects in a supportive and agile environment.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions using .NET / .NET Core , SQL , and AWS technologies. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a strong understanding of application development lifecycle is essential.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using .NET/.NET Core and related technologies
  • Work with SQL databases to design schemas, write queries, and optimize performance
  • Develop and maintain cloud-based applications using AWS
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for streamlined deployment processes
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application issues in a timely manner
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices
  • Contribute to improving development processes and methodologies
  • On-call responsibilities (usually every 3 weeks)


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in software development with .NET / .NET Core
  • Strong experience with SQL and relational databases
  • Strong exp with unit testing (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Strong exp with Kubernetes (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Hands-on experience with AWS
  • Experience with Docker
  • Knowledge of CodeQL
  • Experience working with CI/CD tools and workflows
  • Solid understanding of application development principles and best practices
  • Ability to work independently in a remote team environment
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills


Nice to Have:


  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Exposure to ChatGPT / GPT-4 development or integration of large language models into applications


What We Offer:

  • Fully remote working environment (Brazil-based)
  • Flexible working hours
  • Opportunity to work on modern cloud-native applications

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Senior Software Engineer com forte experiência em Python/FastAPI para liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de novas features, integrações e a evolução arquitetural da nossa plataforma.

Esperamos alguém que tome decisões arquiteturais, defina padrões para o time, mentore engenheiros menos sêniores e trabalhe lado a lado com fundadores e CTO em decisões de produto e infraestrutura.


Sobre a empresa

Somos uma startup de Agentic AI atuando no varejo enterprise no Brasil. Construímos agentes que operam 24/7 em produção, processando volume relevante para grandes redes. Estamos em fase de escala — cada decisão arquitetural tomada hoje impacta nossa capacidade de crescer nos próximos 18-24 meses.


Mais detalhes sobre clientes, parcerias e roadmap são compartilhados durante o processo seletivo, essa é uma oportunidade de trabalhar com IA para as maiores empresa do Brasil.


Responsabilidades


  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução do backend da plataforma
  • Desenhar e implementar sistemas distribuídos escaláveis em produção
  • Arquitetar integrações críticas com sistemas de terceiros
  • Definir padrões de código, testes e observabilidade do time
  • Mentorar engenheiros pleno e júnior, elevando a barra técnica
  • Trabalhar com CTO e fundadores em decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo
  • Garantir confiabilidade, performance e segurança de sistemas transacionais



Stack


  • Linguagem: Python
  • Framework: FastAPI
  • Infraestrutura: Google Cloud Platform
  • Banco de dados: PostgreSQL
  • Práticas: observabilidade ponta a ponta, CI/CD, evals para sistemas não-determinísticos



Perfil Ideal


  • 6+ anos construindo backends em produção, sendo pelo menos 2 como referência técnica de um time
  • Domínio sólido de Python e frameworks assíncronos (FastAPI, asyncio)
  • Experiência desenhando arquiteturas escaláveis e sistemas distribuídos (microsserviços, filas, eventos)
  • Forte experiência com Google Cloud Platform (ou equivalente em AWS/Azure)
  • Conhecimento profundo em autenticação (OAuth2, JWT, SSO) e SQL avançado
  • Experiência integrando APIs externas complexas em produção (webhooks, rate limits, retries, idempotência)
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas com tradeoffs claros e comunicá-las ao time



Diferenciais


  • Experiência construindo features com LLMs em produção (orquestração de agentes, tool use, evals)
  • Experiência em fintech, varejo ou marketplaces
  • Experiência prévia em startup early-stage



Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto
  • Contrato PJ
  • Remuneração competitiva

Mais detalhes sobre clientes, parcerias e roadmap são compartilhados durante o processo seletivo, essa é uma oportunidade de trabalhar com IA para as maiores empresa do Brasil.


Responsabilidades


  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução do backend da plataforma
  • Desenhar e implementar sistemas distribuídos escaláveis em produção
  • Arquitetar integrações críticas com sistemas de terceiros
  • Definir padrões de código, testes e observabilidade do time
  • Mentorar engenheiros pleno e júnior, elevando a barra técnica
  • Trabalhar com CTO e fundadores em decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo

Stack

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
The client is looking to build and scale advanced AI-powered solutions leveraging Generative AI technologies. The project focuses on designing and implementing intelligent systems using LLMs and agentic workflows to enhance business processes and deliver high-impact, scalable products.


General information

They are seeking a senior-level AI Engineer with strong experience in Generative AI and system architecture. The ideal candidate will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable GenAI solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and multi-agent architectures.

This role requires both hands-on technical expertise and the ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and business stakeholders.


Task and Deliverables

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Design and implement GenAI-based systems (LLMs, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, fine-tuning)
  • Build and orchestrate agentic workflows, including multi-agent systems and tool integrations
  • Develop scalable APIs and microservices to support AI-driven applications
  • Contribute to overall system architecture, including cloud-based integrations (AWS and/or Azure)
  • Establish evaluation frameworks to measure performance (accuracy, latency, cost)
  • Continuously optimize models and systems through feedback loops and iteration
  • Provide regular updates to stakeholders on progress, risks, and deliverables


Required Experience

  • Proven hands-on experience with Generative AI technologies (LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering)
  • Solid understanding of AI system architecture and cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure)
  • Working knowledge of Python and relevant AI/ML frameworks
  • Experience with API integration, microservices, and scalable system design
  • Strong communication skills and experience working with global stakeholders


Highlights

  • Long term (12+ monthts)
  • 40 hrs/week

title: Server Manager (Global Project)
description:
Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Nesta função, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.


Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos, solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos

  • Expertise em Linux: Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu. É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA: Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial.
  • Proficiencia em Nuvem: Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF.
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível.


Quem Somos

Talento onde você precisa, quando você precisa! A SGF Global é uma provedora líder de soluções especializadas em talentos, dedicada a conectar profissionais altamente qualificados com oportunidades em diversos setores. Oferecemos soluções de contratação para posições temporárias, permanentes e de contrato para efetivação em áreas como tecnologia, finanças e contabilidade, engenharia, marketing e criação, serviços jurídicos, suporte administrativo e ao cliente, energia, petróleo e gás, telecomunicações, manufatura, aeroespacial, ciências da vida, mineração e utilidades. Na SGF Global, trabalhamos para colocá-lo na melhor posição para ter sucesso. Oferecemos acesso a posições de alto nível, remuneração competitiva, benefícios atrativos e treinamentos online gratuitos. Fique por dentro de todas as oportunidades, a qualquer momento — mesmo em movimento.
