title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)


About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.


About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.


About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred) – Prior experience engaging HR and Finance executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .


Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email Director and above level executives to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.


About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.


About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred) – Prior experience engaging HR and Finance executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.

title: Cloud FinOps Sênior - AWS, Azure e GCP
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um(a) FinOps Cloud que tenha olhar analítico e proatividade para gerenciar e otimizar custos relacionados à infraestrutura em nuvem. Essa pessoa será responsável por consolidar e apresentar dados financeiros e operacionais, garantindo clareza sobre os gastos da área e fornecendo insights estratégicos para a tomada de decisão.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Monitorar e analisar os custos da infraestrutura em Cloud e Datadog, identificando os principais ofensores e oportunidades de otimização.
  • Construir dashboards e relatórios financeiros que consolidem a visão de custos da área, garantindo transparência e controle.
  • Estruturar planilhas detalhadas com projeções e estimativas financeiras, facilitando o planejamento e a tomada de decisão.
  • Garantir a correta aplicação de TAGs nos recursos de Cloud para rastreamento preciso dos gastos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de desenvolvimento, operações e finanças para implementar práticas de FinOps e governança de custos.
  • Atuar de forma proativa, antecipando demandas e garantindo segurança nas informações para a liderança.
  • Preparar e apresentar análises estratégicas para a alta gestão, assegurando clareza sobre os investimentos da área.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Conhecimento básico em Cloud Computing para extração e análise de custos.
  • Experiência com Datadog para obter dados financeiros e de consumo.
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar os principais ofensores de custos.
  • Entendimento de conceitos financeiros para estruturação de planilhas e estimativas.
  • Habilidade para construir dashboards e relatórios gerenciais (ferramenta flexível).
  • Proatividade e autonomia para investigar, consolidar e reportar informações críticas.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para apresentar dados estratégicos para a alta gestão.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+ ;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass ;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Vendedor
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A Multicoisas é uma rede de franquias especializada em oferecer soluções práticas e criativas para o dia a dia das pessoas. Com mais de 40 anos de experiência, a marca é consolidada no mercado brasileiro e possui mais de 150 lojas em todo o Brasil.

Somos a maior rede de varejo brasileira no segmento de utilidades e nos orgulhamos em oferecer soluções, reparos, acessórios e novidades que levam praticidade e conveniência ao dia a dia. Priorizamos a excelência no atendimento ao cliente e a inovação constante, garantindo acessibilidade e qualidade em nossos produtos.

Missão

Oferecer soluções para facilitar o dia a dia das pessoas por meio da excelência no atendimento.


Descrição do Cargo

  • Atender clientes com cordialidade, orientando sobre a utilização e o manuseio adequado dos produtos.


Procuramos um Vendedor para atuar em nossa loja localizada na Rua Maracaju, 1549 – Campo Grande/MS.


Pré-requisitos

  • Gostar de vender e de trabalhar com pessoas;
  • Proatividade;
  • Experiência na área comercial varejista será um diferencial;
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas do Google Workspace ou Pacote Office. 

Benefícios

  • Vale-refeição ou vale-alimentação;
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Café da manhã;
  • Parcerias com academias.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant - Fully Remote


About the job:

We are looking for someone who will help our team with various tasks, has excellent written and spoken English skills, and is attentive to detail and organized.


You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us with some marketing activities for our agency and our clients. title: Fullstack AI Engineer
description:
Fullstack AI Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a Fullstack AI Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle of a high-impact Generative AI MVP, translating complex architectural requirements into technical solutions. You will be responsible for building the bridge between Azure AI Foundry agents and the end-user, developing robust APIs, integrating RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, and implementing a simplified frontend. Beyond technical execution, you will collaborate closely with an AI Specialist and stakeholders to ensure the delivery of an explainable and compliant solution within an Agile framework.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Digest requirements from the architecture and product team to specify the implementation of new features from a fullstack and AI-integration perspective;
  • Implement the designed solution from coding to testing, focusing on Azure Functions, API development, and agentic workflows;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in all development phases to ensure a functional MVP within 3 months;
  • Development of new features, including data connectors for Excel/Word and tool orchestration for LLM agents;
  • Design and maintain the application's frontend to provide a seamless interface for \"Well Engineers\";
  • Participate in the complete cycle of development from requirements gathering, RAG data ingestion, to final deployment;
  • Participate in technical discussions, demonstrations, and reviews with customers (Halliburton/Petrobras context).

Essential Skills

  • Solid Experience with Python (preferred) or Node.js;
  • Frameworks: ReactJS for frontend development;
  • AI Integration: Experience with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar LLM orchestration frameworks;
  • Cloud Knowledge: Solid experience with Azure (Functions, App Service, and Blob Storage);
  • API Development: Experience with REST APIs and integrating third-party AI services;
  • Data Handling: Experience processing structured and unstructured data (Excel/Word) for AI consumption;
  • Solid experience with Git.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Search;
  • Knowledge of Vector Databases and RAG architectures;
  • Experience with automated testing (Unit, Integration) for AI-driven applications;
  • Familiarity with AI Observability tools (Tracing, Prompt Logging);
  • Experience with Tailwind CSS or fast prototyping UI libraries;
  • Knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines within Azure DevOps.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of \"large company\" in 2018. We now have more than 400 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria, as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a \"Lifetime Experience\" where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in Computer Science, IT Engineering, or similar;
  • 5+ years of experience in SAP ABAP development, with a strong focus on HR/HCM modules;

  • Strong knowledge of SAP Business Integration Builder;
  • Solid understanding of SAP HCM processes and HR module configuration;
  • Experience with SAP architecture; knowledge of Outsystems or OpenText is a plus;
  • English proficiency at B2 level or above.

What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;

  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


About the Role

The Data Engineering team is a software-centric group responsible for building and maintaining high-scale data systems that power a large marketplace platform. We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer who can take ownership of end-to-end delivery of complex data infrastructure and high-fidelity integrations.

This is a coding-heavy role that goes beyond traditional data engineering, requiring strong architectural design and the ability to build robust integrations between internal microservices and external partner APIs, in addition to scalable data pipelines.

You will collaborate closely with Data Science, Product, and Core Engineering teams to develop cutting-edge solutions that enhance the company’s data platform capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop code-driven interfaces between the data platform and internal/external services
  • Own projects from requirements gathering through production deployment and monitoring
  • Build scalable data transformations using dbt
  • Design systems that balance technical excellence with business needs, focusing on reliability and maintainability
  • Leverage AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to improve development speed and code quality
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Analytics teams to solve complex data challenges


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering with a strong foundation in system design
  • Strong programming skills with the ability to write production-grade, modular Python code
  • Expert-level SQL skills, including complex data modeling and BigQuery performance optimization
  • Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Dataflow, etc.)
  • Proven experience building integrations with APIs and working with streaming platforms
  • Advanced hands-on experience with dbt (incremental models, testing, and project organization)
  • Experience using AI coding tools to enhance productivity and code quality
  • Strong experience with Git, CI/CD workflows, and Docker/Kubernetes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with data design patterns such as Medallion architecture
  • Experience with Terraform and/or Atlantis


Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field

title: AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)
description:
Job Title - AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)


About the Company

Our client is a US-based AI startup building production AI agents for marketing workflows (SEO, social media, email). The team is led by experienced founders with backgrounds at Meta, Google, and Scale AI.

This is a product engineering role, not research. You’ll build AI agents that ship, scale, and are used by real customers.


About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on AI Product Engineer who can own features end-to-end: frontend, backend, and AI logic.

You will build AI agents inside real products, not demos — working closely with the CTO and founders to design, implement, and iterate quickly.


What You’ll Do

  • Build AI-powered product features using React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Implement LLM-based agents that perform real business workflows
  • Design and maintain RAG pipelines (retrieval, chunking, embeddings, evaluation)
  • Integrate third-party APIs, web scraping, and internal data sources
  • Own features from idea → production → iteration
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions in a fast-moving startup environment


Must-Have Requirements

  • 6+ years total engineering experience
  • 4+ years of professional experience as a software / product engineer
  • 2+ years working with LLMs, AI agents, or generative AI systems
  • Strong hands-on experience with React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Proven experience building AI agents or LLM-powered features used in production


Solid understanding of RAG systems, including:

  • Retrieval quality tradeoffs
  • Chunking strategies
  • Hallucination risks and mitigation
  • Comfortable working without heavy frameworks or abstractions
  • Able to explain technical decisions clearly, concretely, and concisely
  • Startup mindset: moves fast, owns outcomes, and ships
  • Experience with Pinecone, pgvector, or similar vector databases
  • Web scraping, data ingestion pipelines, or third-party API integrations
  • Prior experience in marketing, SEO, or growth-related products


Logistics

  • Full-time (40 hrs/week). US Time Zones
  • Starting ASAP

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.


We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Onboarding Specialist. You will own the customers' first 30 - 45 days, set the tone for the relationship, build confidence and ensure customers are ready quickly and correctly. This role defines the customer’s first impression of Smarter Contact and has clear growth potential within a fast-scaling SaaS company. This is a direct-hire role.


What You’ll Own:

  • Lead and follow up on all 1-1 or group onboarding sessions via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Guide customers through initial setup, configuration, and first live campaigns
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Ensure customers reach defined activation milestones within the onboarding window
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or risk during onboarding-escalate and resolve
  • Document onboarding outcomes, next steps, and handoff notes clearly in CRM
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience to ensure a clean transition post onboarding.
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday

title: Data Analyst
description:
About The Role


You'll join the Reporting & Analytics team at Pride Global — a high-impact, cross-functional group responsible for delivering data-driven insights across our global staffing operations.

This role sits at the center of how the business makes decisions. You’ll be responsible for building the reporting layer that powers executive dashboards, client presentations, and operational insights across the US, Canada, UK, and Brazil.

This is not just a dashboarding role. You’ll translate complex workforce, financial, and market data into clear, actionable narratives used by senior leadership and global business heads.

We need someone who can take ambiguous business questions, structure them into analytical problems, and deliver high-quality reporting solutions end-to-end — from data modeling to final presentation.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards used in executive-level reporting and client-facing presentations
  • Build self-service reporting solutions that allow business stakeholders to explore data independently
  • Create clean, intuitive, and visually effective dashboards optimized for both desktop and mobile consumption
  • Develop and manage Power BI datasets, workspaces, and deployment pipelines across Dev / UAT / Prod
  • Model data using star and snowflake schemas, applying best practices in DAX and Power Query (M)
  • Integrate and transform data from multiple sources — ATS, VMS/MSP platforms, SQL databases, Excel, SharePoint, and HR/ERP systems
  • Partner with business leaders to understand reporting needs and translate them into structured analytical outputs
  • Present insights and guide stakeholders through dashboards, explaining trends, limitations, and opportunities
  • Support recurring reporting cycles (weekly, monthly, quarterly) with accurate and timely delivery
  • Define and standardize key business metrics (headcount, spend, fill rates, aging, profitability, etc.)
  • Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and validation rules within reporting layers
  • Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic to ensure long-term scalability and governance


What We’re Looking For

Must have (3–5 years of experience):

  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, RLS)
  • Solid SQL skills (joins, aggregations, query optimization, working with relational databases)
  • Experience building reporting solutions for operational, workforce, or business performance data
  • Proven ability to design clean, executive-level dashboards with clear storytelling and minimal noise
  • Experience managing Power BI Service (workspaces, refresh schedules, access control, deployments)
  • Ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate insights effectively
  • Strong English communication skills (you’ll work with global stakeholders daily)


Nice to have:

  • Experience in staffing, workforce, or HR analytics
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud data platforms
  • Basic experience with Python or R for data preparation or automation
  • Exposure to data governance practices (metric standardization, data lineage, documentation)
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments (finance, operations, delivery teams)

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
We are seeking a Customer Service / Sales Support Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you will serve as a key link between our clients, partners, and internal teams. Your primary responsibility will be to help users throughout their experience on our platform, ensuring they can communicate smoothly and receive exceptional service. 


Responsibilities:  

  • Provide frontline support to clients during account registration, identity verification, deposits, withdrawals, and general platform use. 
  • Respond to customer inquiries via live chat, email, and phone with professionalism, empathy, and clarity. 
  • Monitor and resolve issues related to account access, transactions, and platform functionality, escalating when necessary. 
  • Collaborate with the sales and operations teams to ensure timely follow-up and a seamless customer experience. 
  • Maintain accurate client and partner information in CRM systems. 
  • Support service campaigns focused on client satisfaction, retention, and community engagement. 
  • Track common questions and issues to help improve internal processes and FAQs. 

Qualifications:  

  • 1–2 years of experience in customer service or sales support roles. 
  • Strong communication skills in English (professional level). 
  • Empathetic, patient, and solution-oriented when dealing with customers. 
  • Comfortable using CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce). 
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Experience in fintech, digital platforms, or affiliate programs is a plus. 

What We Offer:  

  • Ongoing training and growth opportunities 
  • Supportive team culture 
  • Exposure to a global customer base and a fast-evolving industry 


Job type: Full-Time (Remote) 

Pay: $700USD/month

title: Consulting Partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role; it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation


What You Bring

  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
  • Confidence in engaging with CxO-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice



This is the ideal next step if you’re seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.


By applying, you agree to the use of your personal data for recruitment and related communications, in accordance with the UK GDPR.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, candidate responsible for own taxes)

Contract: 6 Months (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer to join a software-centric data engineering team responsible for building and maintaining high-scale data systems. This role involves owning the end-to-end delivery of complex data infrastructure and high-fidelity integrations.

This is a coding-heavy position requiring strong expertise in building robust integrations between internal microservices and external partner APIs, as well as developing scalable data pipelines. You will collaborate closely with Data Science, Product and Engineering teams to deliver advanced data platform capabilities.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop code-driven interfaces between the data platform and internal/external services
  • Take projects from initial requirements gathering through to production deployment and proactive monitoring
  • Build scalable data transformations using dbt
  • Design systems that balance technical excellence with business needs, ensuring reliability and long-term maintainability
  • Leverage AI-assisted coding tools (such as Cursor, Claude) to improve development speed and code quality
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Analytics teams to solve complex data challenges


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering with a strong foundation in system design
  • Strong coding skills with the ability to write production-grade, modular Python code
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL, including complex data modeling and query optimization
  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Dataflow, etc.)
  • Proven experience building integrations using APIs and working with streaming platforms
  • Advanced hands-on experience with dbt (incremental models, testing, project organization)
  • Experience using AI coding tools to enhance productivity and code quality
  • Strong experience with Git, CI/CD workflows, and Docker/Kubernetes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Requirements

  • Knowledge of data design patterns such as Medallion architecture
  • Experience with Terraform or Atlantis

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Video Editor — E-commerce Ads
description:
About Us:

We run 3 health brands across the US and EU. By end of 2025 we were doing $50K days with a team of 3. Now we are scaling to $150K days and need editors who want to own their craft.


About the Role:

You will edit video ads for Meta that actually convert. You see the results. You iterate. When your ads win, you get paid for it.


Responsibilities:

- Edit short and long form video ads for Meta

- Source b-roll from TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest

- Create hook variations

- Same day turnarounds on variations


Requirements:

- Experience editing Meta ads for e-commerce

- Understanding of what makes an ad convert - hooks, pacing, visuals

- Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar

- Ability to work independently


Compensation:

- $2,000-$5,000 USD/month base depending on experience

- Performance bonuses up to $500/month per brand for top performing ads

- Full training program provided before you start


Job type: Full-time or Part-time

Schedule: Flexible

Location: Remote

title: Criador de Conteúdo (Vídeos sobre AEC)
description:
Na Blocks, transformamos o setor de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção com soluções inovadoras baseadas no Revit. Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional que seja apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, comunicação e tendências do mercado, para ser a cara da Blocks nas redes sociais e na comunidade.



Sobre a Blocks

A Blocks é uma empresa de tecnologia, possui um software próprio e se dedica a digitalizar produtos reais em modelos 3D de alta qualidade, fornecendo ferramentas essenciais para otimizar os processos de trabalho de arquitetos, engenheiros e designers de interiores ao redor do mundo.


️ O que esperamos de você:

  • Ser a voz e o rosto da Blocks em vídeos, tutoriais e conteúdos técnicos;
  • Produzir e gravar vídeos sobre o plugin para Revit, mostrando como eles otimizam processos no setor;
  • Falar sobre tendências de mercado e tecnologia no nosso setor, conectando o público com as novidades do momento;
  • Criar conteúdos criativos e envolventes, alinhados com a identidade da Blocks;
  • Interagir com a comunidade online, promovendo engajamento e respondendo a perguntas sobre nossos produtos e temas relacionados.
  • Auxílio em criação dos roteiros e materiais desenvolvidos
  • Auxiliar o time de marketing em outras funcões necessárias.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa ou em andamento na área de arquitetura, designer de interiores ou áreas afins
  • Experiência com redes sociais e estratégias de conteúdo digital 
  • Habilidade em comunicação escrita e verbal 
  • Experiência com criação de vídeos 
  • Ser criativo(a) 
  • Conhecimento no plugin da Blocks (diferencial)
  • Conhecimento no software Revit (diferencial) 


  O que oferecemos:

  • Remuneração: R$ 3.000,00 (CLT)
  • Half-day Fridays – termine sua sexta-feira mais cedo.
  • Trabalho 100% Home Office – com escritório virtual.
  • Plano de saúde com subsídio.
  • Vale alimentação via iFood, no valor de R$31,00 por dia útil.
  • Seguro de vida sem custo ao colaborador. 
  • Auxílio educação para cursos, eventos e livros da área profissionalizante.
  • Auxílio creche para pais e mães com filhos até 4 anos de idade.
  • Wellhub: acesso a academias e estúdios 
  • Bem-estar com Avus e Starbem: atendimento psicológico, médico e outros serviços de saúde.
  • Parceria com o SESC: descontos em eventos e serviços.
  • Day off no mês do aniversário, para você comemorar como quiser!

title: Data Annotator - Portuguese
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the Role


Job Title: Data Annotator

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible; minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Eligibility: Open to candidates with a Bachelor’s degree



We are seeking Data Annotator to support a data annotation and linguistic quality project aimed at training Large Language Models (LLMs) . This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours.

The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy.


Key Responsibilities


  • Perform data annotation, and text evaluation in accordance with project-specific guidelines.
  • Ensure high-quality, accurate, and contextually relevant annotations to support Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Review, validate, and refine AI-generated content for grammatical, semantic, and contextual accuracy.
  • Maintain consistency and quality across all deliverables while adhering to established project standards and timelines.
  • Collaborate effectively with the project team to provide feedback and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with all project deadlines and quality assurance protocols.


Required Skills & Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in mandatory.
  • Native proficiency in German language and the English language
  • Prior experience in data annotation , linguistic evaluation , or AI training projects.


What Makes This Role Exciting


  • Fully remote opportunity , allowing you to work comfortably from home.
  • Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule.
  • The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives , shaping the future of language technology.


Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?


About the job

As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.

  • Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors
  • Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.


Requirements

  • With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend.
  • Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture.
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts.
  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
  • Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these.
  • Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment
  • Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools.
  • Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs.
  • Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life.
  • Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications.

title: Consultor SAP SD OTC/PTP (AMS)
description:
Consultor SAP SD OTC/PTP (AMS) - 14116


Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto

Horário de Trabalho: comercial

Contratação Pj ou Cooperativa


Conhecimentos e Competências Necessárias:

• Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência comprovada como consultor SAP SD/OTC e nível intermediário em MM/P2P, com atuação prática em configuração e suporte aos processos order-to-cash e procure-to-pay.

• Inglês avançado/fluente

• Forte conhecimento em SAP S/4HANA, incluindo integração entre os módulos SD, MM e FI. É necessário conhecimento em EDI.

• Experiência com SAP S/4HANA public cloud será considerada um diferencial.

• Capacidade de analisar processos de negócio complexos e projetar soluções SAP eficazes.

• Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas, comunicação e gestão de stakeholders.

• Experiência em treinamento de usuários e elaboração de documentação.

• Conhecimento dos processos de compras, execução logística e financeiros no SAP.

• Preferencialmente experiência com metodologia ITIL.

• Familiaridade com ferramentas ITSM (ServiceNow, ManageEngine ou similares) para gestão de chamados.

• Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Supply Chain, Administração ou áreas relacionadas.


Responsabilidades:

• Fornecer suporte funcional e técnico para os processos SAP (SD) e (MM), incluindo gestão de pedidos, entregas, faturamento, compras, processamento de faturas e pagamentos.

• Configurar e manter os módulos SAP SD (Sales & Distribution) e MM (Materials Management) para atender aos requisitos de negócio relacionados ao cumprimento de pedidos e à área de compras.

• Analisar necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções SAP, especialmente nas áreas de execução logística, compras e integração financeira.

• Apoiar o design, implementação e otimização das funcionalidades do SAP S/4HANA para os ciclos OTC e P2P.

• Colaborar com as áreas de negócio para levantamento de requisitos, condução de workshops e entrega de melhorias de processos.

• Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados ao processamento de pedidos, compras e pontos de integração entre os módulos SD, MM e FI. É necessário conhecimento em EDI.

• Desenvolver e manter documentação, incluindo especificações funcionais, guias de configuração e materiais de treinamento.

• Conduzir treinamentos para usuários e oferecer suporte contínuo para garantir o uso eficaz do sistema.

• Manter-se atualizado sobre inovações do SAP S/4HANA, especialmente nos módulos SD e MM, e recomendar melhores práticas para melhoria contínua.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante a entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: US Payroll Analyst
description:
The main objective of this role is to review payroll data and documentation for assigned clients, ensuring that all values are accurate based on employees worked hours, guaranteeing traceability and providing consistent, value-added support to clients.


Responsibilities:


  • Review quarterly and annual reports to ensure proper submission of payroll records to the IRS.
  • Input client-reported information for payroll processing.
  • Follow up with clients through meetings and emails to ensure that the information entered into ADP/Accountants World is accurate.
  • Enter information into the Accountants World platform for quarterly clients.
  • Review 1099 forms annually in accordance with information provided by Account Managers.
  • Perform all tasks related to the role based on knowledge and capabilities.


Education:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Accounting, or related fields.


Experience:


  • Minimum of 1 year supporting US payroll processes.
  • Advanced English level – required.


Skills:


  • Customer Orientation
  • Attention to Detail
  • Learning Agility
  • Communication
  • Teamwork

title: 3D Product Rendering Artist (Freelance)
description:
Are you looking to work for an innovative and exciting company from Silicon Valley or New York, 100% remotely?

We are looking for multi-skilled candidates with excellent creative and execution skills for the position of Product Render Expert (Freelance).

We are seeking highly talented Render Experts who can create high-quality, visually compelling product renders and animations for eCommerce, landing pages, and paid media. The ideal candidate has a strong eye for design, motion, lighting, and storytelling, and is able to take minimal direction and turn it into premium, production-ready visuals.


This role is project-based, with opportunities to collaborate in ongoing creative sprints. Candidates should be comfortable working independently and delivering high-quality work under limited guidance.

The compensation range is $5 to $20 USD per hour , depending on the candidate’s experience and quality of work.


Candidates from Latin America are highly encouraged to apply.

Candidates in a time zone outside of the western hemisphere will NOT be considered.

The role is 100% remote.

ALL RESUMES MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH


Responsibilities:

  • Create high-quality product renders and short animations for web, social media, and paid advertising
  • Produce clean, modern, and premium visuals with strong attention to detail
  • Work with minimal direction to develop creative concepts and visual storytelling
  • Execute lighting, materials, and composition that enhance product appeal
  • Develop looping animations (5–10 seconds) suitable for digital platforms
  • Adapt renders across different backgrounds and formats
  • Collaborate in short creative sprints (audit + initial concepts + execution)
  • Continuously iterate and improve assets based on feedback


Requirements:

  • Proven experience creating high-quality product renders (portfolio required)
  • Strong skills in 3D rendering, lighting, materials, and composition
  • Experience with animation and motion design (looping animations preferred)
  • Ability to create realistic and visually appealing product imagery
  • Strong sense of modern design, aesthetics, and visual storytelling
  • Ability to work independently with limited direction
  • Experience working on eCommerce, branding, or paid media content
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on execution quality
  • Comfortable working on short, fast-paced projects (sprint-based work)


Assessment (Required):

As part of the process, candidates will complete a short render challenge designed to evaluate:

  • Product realism and material quality
  • Motion and animation quality
  • Creative thinking and execution
  • Attention to detail and overall design taste

This assignment is intended to be brief (~2 hours) and focuses on showcasing your approach and skills.


English Requirement:

Fluent in English — YOU MUST BE ABLE TO HAVE A FLUENT PROFESSIONAL CONVERSATION IN ENGLISH

title: AI /ML Developer | specialist
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Projetar e implementar soluções de Machine Learning e GenAI end-to-end
  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de AI escaláveis, seguras e resilientes
  • Desenvolver, treinar, avaliar e operacionalizar modelos de ML e LLMs
  • Criar e manter pipelines de dados, treinamento e deployment
  • Atuar com Prompt Engineering, RAG, agentes e orquestração de workflows de AI
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps (versionamento, monitoramento e governança)
  • Trabalhar com Kubernetes (K8s), Helm e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Desenvolver APIs, serviços e automações com foco em qualidade
  • Atuar em ambientes cloud (OCI e GCP), otimizando custo, performance e segurança
  • Colaborar com times de Produto, Dados, Engenharia e Segurança
  • Apoiar decisões técnicas com visão estratégica e foco em negócio


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida como ML Engineer Sênior ou equivalente
  • Forte vivência com Machine Learning em produção
  • Domínio de Kubernetes (K8s) e Helm
  • Experiência com CI/CD aplicado a ML e software
  • Background robusto em engenharia de software
  • Experiência com arquitetura de soluções de AI/ML
  • Atuação em projetos end-to-end (E2E)
  • Experiência com cloud (OCI e/ou GCP)

  • Experiência com MLflow, Kedro, Apache Airflow ou similares
  • Vivência com RAG, agentes autônomos e avaliação de LLMs
  • Conhecimento em FinOps aplicado a workloads de AI

title: Senior Studio Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Senior Studio Specialist at JoVE , you will drive the operational excellence of our in-house creative studio. You will execute and oversee project execution, optimize workflows, and introduce AI-powered solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who understands the full creative production lifecycle and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment - a love for science is a plus!


Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and coordinate the execution of creative projects from brief to final delivery
  • Maintain the studio production schedule and assign projects to the in-house motion graphics team based on availability, timelines, and project scope.
  • Track the day-to-day progress of projects in the pipeline, follow up on deadlines, flag delays, and ensure workload distribution supports on-time delivery.
  • Define and track KPIs, deadlines, and performance metrics to ensure smooth production cycles
  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing to translate business objectives into actionable creative plans
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to refine briefs and propose effective design solutions
  • Create and edit high-quality video assets to support marketing campaigns, product launches, digital initiatives, and brand awareness efforts.
  • Design, document, and continuously improve studio workflows and cross-functional processes
  • Ensure brand consistency and creative quality standards across all deliverables
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements to increase efficiency
  • Lead the integration of AI technologies into creative workflows, including automation, asset generation, project tracking, and quality optimization


Requirements:

  • 5–7 years of experience in creative production, studio coordination, or motion graphics environments
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent creative projects while ensuring quality and on-time delivery
  • Strong experience supporting and improving production workflows within creative teams
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate designers and balance workloads effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana (or similar platforms)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to improve production efficiency and creative output
  • Strong attention to detail and quality control across all stages of the creative process
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle (briefing, design, review, revisions, final delivery)


Why Join JoVE?

  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Closer
description:
APENAS APLIQUE SE VOCÊ TEM EXPERIÊNCIA COM VENDAS HIGH TICKET E HISTÓRICO DE METAS BATIDAS


Sobre a HarmonizaPRO: Somos a maior aceleradora comercial para clinicas de harmonização facial do Brasil! Impactamos mais de 400 clinicas ao longo de 5 anos. Nosso papel é aumentar demanda, ticket médio e implementar um departamento comercial terceirizado para nós na clínica. Dessa forma conseguimos garantir o paciente sentado na cadeira da nossa cliente.


Se você tem experiência com vendas e busca um lugar de destaque em uma empresa em ascenção, essa vaga é para você. A HarmonizaPRO tem 48 colaboradores, investimos 150k+ em anúncios por mês e temos uma meta agressiva para esse ano. Temos uma CIA com pessoas idôneas e ambiciosas, todos aqui querem botar mais dinheiro no bolso e procuramos pessoas com o mesmo perfil cultural.


Ponto de extrema importância: mais do que um bom vendedor, estamos buscando um(a) excelente consultor(a). Aquela pessoa que conhece sobre negócios e ditará o melhor programa/produto para o cliente é quem buscamos. Se você pensa em apenas fazer um \"bico\" aqui, pegar algumas calls e tratar como um hobbie, pode passar para frente, não queremos você.

Queremos pessoas comprometidas, que tenham empatia com o sonho dos demais colaboradores e dos clientes para mantermos um ambiente de desenvolvimento contínuo.

Respiramos e vibramos a cada venda, mas o destaque sempre será nas vendas em que proporcionamos aos nossos clientes, essas vibramos ainda mais!

A HarmonizaPRO é uma ferramenta de transformação de vidas, e ela pode mudar a sua também.


  • Responsabilidades:
  • Conduzir reuniões de vendas consultivas (média 4-6 calls/dia)
  • Fechar contratos de R$12k a R$60k
  • Gerir seu pipeline no Pipedrive com disciplina
  • Nutrir leads com follow-ups estratégicos
  • Participar das rotinas do time (daily, weekly, 1:1)


  • Requisitos:
  • Experiência comprovada como vendedor (com resultados para mostrar)
  • Comunicação consultiva
  • Disciplina de processo e CRM
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolver problemas sem precisar de babá
  • Ambição real de ganhar dinheiro
  • Conversão acima de 20%


  • Remuneração:
  • R$5.000,00 fixo inicial.
  • Comissão de 3% sobre o valor recebido, podendo chegar a 5% com progressão de taxa de conversão de vendas (média salarial de 12k a 28k).
  • +Bônus por metas batidas.


  • Regime de contratação: PJ.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto, mas temos sede presencial para trabalhar também
  • Horário: Integral.
  • Apesar do contrato ser PJ, prezamos pela sua exclusividade com nossa empresa.

title: Analista de desenvolvimento de novos negócios II
description:
Descrição da vaga

SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Mapear e analisar oportunidades de projetos futuros no segmento de transmissão de energia.
  • Avaliar documentos setoriais relacionados ao planejamento da expansão da transmissão no Brasil.
  • Contribuir para a elaboração e atualização do planejamento estratégico da área de transmissão.
  • Estruturar novos negócios e apoiar a definição de estratégias de participação em projetos e leilões.
  • Realizar análises de mercado, incluindo avaliação de concorrência, tendências e oportunidades no setor.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação em Engenharia ou Economia.
  • Visão estratégica aplicada ao setor elétrico, com compreensão da dinâmica de expansão da transmissão.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento ou avaliação de projetos no segmento de transmissão de energia.
  • Conhecimento do modelo regulatório e do ambiente de negócios da transmissão no Brasil.
  • Domínio de ferramentas computacionais, com ênfase em:
  • Excel avançado
  • Estruturação e manipulação de bases de dados
  • Ferramentas de Business Intelligence (BI)

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência na análise de documentos setoriais relacionados à expansão da transmissão, como Relatórios R, PET/PELP, POTEE, PAR/PEL e editais de leilões.
  • Experiência em análise econômico-financeira de projetos.
  • Conhecimento na estruturação e estimativa de CAPEX e cronograma de projetos de transmissão.
  • Capacidade de condução e coordenação de projetos multidisciplinares.


Informações adicionais

Benefícios:


Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. Alguns dos benefícios que disponibilizamos estão disponíveis abaixo:

• Vale-refeição e vale-alimentação;

• Plano Médico e Odontológico;

• Seguro de Vida;

• Previdência Privada;

• Vale-Transporte;

• Wellhub;

• Auxílio-creche;

• Auxílio-educacional;

Se esses benefícios e essa posição fazem sentido para você, inscreva-se já!

title: Business Strategy Consultant
description:
Organizations collect mountains of data about their customers — and still struggle to act on it. They run surveys, build dashboards, and generate reports, but often lack the structured thinking to turn those outputs into decisions that actually change the business. This role exists to close that gap.


Responsibilities:

  • Diagnosing drivers of customer satisfaction, loyalty, and operational performance across enterprise clients.
  • Structuring insights from large datasets and Voice of Customer programs into strategic recommendations.
  • Developing analytical frameworks that connect behavioral and operational data to business outcomes.
  • Building executive presentations and data-driven narratives for C-level and senior stakeholders.
  • Contributing to consulting proposals and new service offerings — translating insights into commercial value propositions.
  • Supporting the development of consulting methodologies, tools, and analytical approaches.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or Marketing.
  • 3–6 years of experience in roles such as Strategy consulting, Business analytics or insights, Strategic planning, Business intelligence, or data-driven product roles.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Desired Skills:

  • Fluency in Spanish.
  • Experience with customer analytics, Voice of Customer programs, or customer journey analysis.

title: AWS AI /ML Developer| Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Desenhar e implementar a camada de orquestração com AgentCore Runtime
  • Definir arquitetura de agentes (principal e subagentes), padrões A2A e estratégias de roteamento
  • Implementar lógica de fallback, handoff para Zendesk e gestão de contexto
  • Configurar guardrails, prompt filtering, output moderation e tratamento de PII
  • Liderar decisões técnicas sobre seleção de LLMs e integração com Amazon Bedrock
  • Revisar código, mentorar profissionais mais juniores e garantir a qualidade da arquitetura


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência com Amazon Bedrock e integração com LLMs
  • Arquitetura multi-agente e protocolos A2A
  • Python e desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful
  • Experiência com LangChain e/ou LangFlow
  • Engenharia de prompt e implementação de guardrails
  • Experiência com AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB)
  • Arquitetura de software e arquitetura cloud
  • Conhecimento em segurança aplicada a LLMs
  • Versionamento com Git

title: Social Media Assistant
description:
Você é apaixonado por redes sociais e acredita que um bom conteúdo pode transformar um negócio local?

Então essa vaga é pra você!


Estamos procurando um(a) Social Media Pleno para integrar o time da maior agência de gastronomia, com atuação em mais de 180 restaurantes, bares e comércios da região.

A agência é comandada pelos criadores das maiores páginas de dicas da cidade: @ComendoPorCampinas e @EstrangeirosSP, referências em gastronomia e experiências locais.


Sobre a vaga:

Você irá apoiar na criação, agendamento e organização de conteúdos digitais, com foco em fortalecer a presença online dos nossos clientes.


✨ Suas principais responsabilidades:

• Criar e organizar calendários editoriais;

• Criar legendas, roteiros e ideias criativas para posts, stories e reels;

• Editar vídeos chamativos no CapCut;

• Agendar publicações em ferramentas como Meta Business, mLabs, etc;

• Fazer benchmarking e acompanhar tendências de redes sociais;

• Apoiar no acompanhamento e organização de indicadores de desempenho.


Pré-requisitos:

• Escrita criativa e boa comunicação;

• Organização e responsabilidade com prazos;

• Interesse por redes sociais e conteúdo gastronômico;

• Morar em Campo Grande / MS

title: PMO #1003033
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que você precisa ter?

Procuramos por PMO para gerenciar e liderar o roadmap de desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas que suportarão projetos de dados, garantindo a orquestração entre squads, stakeholders e áreas de negócio, com foco em governança, arquitetura, engenharia e produtos de dados. É esperado que você combine a disciplina da gestão clássica de projetos com práticas ágeis modernas, dominando ferramentas e metodologias de ponta.


Requisitos:

  • Roadmap integrado com priorizações, desdobramentos e marcos.
  • Plano de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders (matriz RACI, mapeamento de impacto).
  • Métricas de sucesso do projeto e controle de entregas por squad ou frente.
  • Cronograma de capacitação e readiness (documentação, UAT, suporte de pós-go live).
  • Acompanhamento estruturado por metodologia híbrida (ágil + tradicional).
  • Planejamento e execução de Sprint 0 e fases Discovery, se aplicável.
  • Liderança: Capacidade de coordenar múltiplos times e níveis organizacionais com clareza, empatia e foco em resultado.
  • Comunicação executiva: Consegue transitar bem entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, ajustando linguagem e reportes.
  • Visão de produto e entrega: Compreende o ciclo completo de soluções de dados – da engenharia à aplicação no negócio.
  • Autonomia e ownership: Alta capacidade de autogestão, priorização e tomada de decisão em ambientes ambíguos.
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis
  • Governança de dados (DAMA, LGPD, catálogos, data quality, linhagem).
  • Ferramentas de visualização: Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Metabase.
  • Ferramentas de gestão de projetos: Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Project.
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e tradicionais (PMBOK, PRINCE2).
  • Conhecimento em produtos de dados, data mesh e arquiteturas modernas (data lake, cloud, event-driven).
  • Storytelling com dados: saber transformar indicadores e métricas em narrativas acionáveis.
  • Inglês fluente (Necessário para comunicação).


O que você fará no seu dia a dia?

  • Atuar como liderança técnica e referência na visão de cliente e negócio, fortalecendo o relacionamento com stakeholders internos e apoiando o desenvolvimento do time.
  • Ter forte orientação a negócio, compreendendo operações, métricas e processos para apoiar a tomada de decisão e o atingimento de metas.
  • Disseminar conhecimento por meio de documentação clara e comunicação efetiva entre pares e áreas.
  • Demonstrar atitude de dono, aplicando boas práticas em processos, tecnologias e entregas, com foco em resultados.
  • Atuar como interface entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia, conduzindo escopos de curto, médio e longo prazo com comunicação clara e assertiva.
  • Gerenciar projetos e programas de dados com múltiplas squads e alto nível de complexidade técnica e funcional.
  • Planejar e acompanhar roadmaps, cronogramas e marcos, garantindo previsibilidade das entregas.
  • Garantir business readiness, coordenando comunicação, treinamentos, documentação e alinhamentos necessários.
  • Facilitar rituais ágeis quando aplicável (Planning, Review, Retrospective).
  • Orquestrar dependências entre times de dados, produtos, arquitetura e governança.
  • Estabelecer rotinas de comunicação e reportes com stakeholders, acompanhando indicadores e progresso.
  • Organizar entregáveis finais como go-live, guias operacionais, planos de suporte e trilhas de capacitação.


Local de atuação: No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: UI/UX Designer (Salesforce)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,800 - $2,200 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a UI/UX Designer with Salesforce Experience. You will be a champion of the end-user within their Salesforce projects. Your mission is to transform complex business processes into intuitive, high-fidelity digital experiences. You will apply user-centered design principles to the Salesforce platform, ensuring that solutions are not only functional but delightful to use. You will work closely with stakeholders to conduct user research and translate those insights into wireframes and prototypes that adhere to the Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS).


Must-have Technical Skills:

  • Proven Experience: 3+ years of professional UI/UX design experience with a strong portfolio showcasing user-centered design solutions.
  • Design Tools: Mastery of Figma (preferred), Sketch, or Adobe XD for creating high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes. Avonni is a plus.
  • Design Systems: Deep expertise in working with and extending design systems; specifically, a strong working knowledge of the Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS).
  • User Research: Experience conducting user interviews, surveys, and usability testing to validate design decisions.
  • Information Architecture: Ability to create site maps, user task flows, and wireframes that simplify complex Salesforce data structures.
  • Visual Design: Strong eye for typography, color theory, and layout, with a focus on creating accessible and responsive web interfaces.
  • Prototyping: Ability to build click-through prototypes to communicate interactions and transitions to stakeholders and developers.


Salesforce Specific Knowledge:

  • Platform Awareness: Understanding of Salesforce \"Out-of-the-Box\" layout capabilities and limitations (e.g., Lightning App Builder, Page Layouts, and Dynamic Forms).
  • Component-Based Design: Familiarity with how Salesforce components behave to ensure designs are technically feasible for developers to build.
  • Experience Cloud: Knowledge of the branding and styling capabilities within Salesforce Experience Builder.


Desirable Skills:

  • Accessibility: Knowledge of WCAG 2.1 compliance and how to apply accessibility standards within a Salesforce environment.
  • Workshop Facilitation: Experience leading Design Thinking workshops or discovery sessions with clients.


Interpersonal Skills:

  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate business goals into logical user journeys.
  • Collaboration: Experience working in an Agile environment alongside Business Analysts and Salesforce Developers.
  • Storytelling: Strong ability to present design concepts and \"sell\" the UX vision to non-technical stakeholders.


Certifications:

  • Salesforce Certified User Experience (UX) Designer (Highly Preferred)
  • Salesforce Certified Strategy Designer (Desirable)
  • Google UX Design Professional Certificate or similar industry accreditation.


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, UI/UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or a related field.
  • Equivalent professional portfolio and work experience.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to design user-centered Salesforce experiences that transform complex business processes into intuitive and impactful solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


Work Schedule: Full-time (160-hours/month) working core EST US time zone.


Project timeline: May 4th to December 31st, 2026


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

description:
